summary: Lattice Semiconductor filed an 8-K to disclose entry into a Second Amended and Restated Credit Agreement with Wells Fargo, providing a $200M revolving loan facility and a $950M delayed draw term loan facility. The delayed draw term loan is expressly tied to funding a portion of the cash purchase price for the previously announced AMI acquisition. No new deal terms are announced here; the filing is a routine credit facility amendment. The revolving facility matures in 2031 with no current borrowings. This is a financing step, not a new special situation event.
